verdict.rationale: Lambda lets you choose a different base image through the API, such as the minimal GPU Base image. You can also script your exact environment at launch with cloud-init, and Managed Kubernetes on 1-Click Clusters lets you deploy workloads, which implies containers. However, the evidence never documents bringing your own Docker image to an instance or saving and reusing a custom machine template. Missing for 10: explicit support for user-supplied Docker or container images on instances, custom image or snapshot creation and reuse, documentation of which base images are allowed, independent hands-on corroboration.
